# Muppaal Digital

> Strategic Growth Consultant for B2B Brands

Muppaal Digital (https://muppaaldigital.com) is the specialized B2B growth and AI search visibility (SEO, AEO, GEO) consulting practice led by Sivaprasad C.

## The Muppaal Growth Strategy
Three Dimensions. One Growth Strategy.

- 01. Digital Foundation (BUILD): Website, Content, Social. Build a credible, consistent, and discoverable digital presence.
- 02. Search & AI Visibility (REACH): SEO (Traditional Search), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Make the business visible across traditional search engines, AI-powered platforms, and emerging discovery channels.
- 03. Business Growth (GROW): Branding, Demand Generation, Conversion. Translate visibility into qualified opportunities and measurable business outcomes.

## The 10-Pillar Audit Framework (292 Audit Subchecks)
1. Business Alignment & Commercial Intent
2. Entity & Knowledge Footprint (Wikidata QIDs, Knowledge Graph verification)
3. Topical Authority & Semantic Depth
4. Buyer Journey & Intent Architecture
5. Search Visibility & SERP Ownership
6. AI Visibility (GEO & LLM Mentions, Share of Model)
7. Content Quality & E-E-A-T Effectiveness (EAV-E Prose structure)
8. Technical Foundation & AI Accessibility (/llms.txt, JSON-LD @graph schemas)
9. Competitive Intelligence & Share of Model
10. Demand & Conversion Infrastructure
